How to play Sunday Split

Five real fantasy matchups. Five calls. How well can you read a lineup?

The Daily Five

  1. Compare two actual starting lineups. Each round comes from a completed head-to-head Sleeper matchup. Both lineups are shown, with their points hidden.
  2. Read the clues. Check the season, NFL week, league scoring, each starter's opponent, and their recent form. LAST 3 on desktop, or L3G on mobile, means their average across the last three available prior NFL regular-season appearances, using that league's scoring. Fewer appearances are labeled accordingly.
  3. Pick A or B. Lock in the lineup you think scored more. There is one pick per matchup, not five attempts at the same matchup.
  4. Watch the reveal. Starter points and lineup totals appear by position. Afterward, see the winning margin and dig into the Film Room.
  5. Finish all five. Your result is winners picked out of five. Share a spoiler-free result or challenge friends to the exact same set.

Everyone gets the same current-season Daily Five for the same date. A new set becomes available on your next visit after midnight Eastern (America/Toronto). There is no countdown on making a pick.

How scoring works

Your score out of five counts winners picked, regardless of hints. The separate points total rewards unassisted picks, up to ten points across five rounds.

Hints and recent form

Once per standard round, you can reveal the actual points for the same starting slot on both lineups. A hint changes a correct call from two points to one. Opponents, recent averages, and form graphs are free clues, not scored hints. Recent form uses only appearances before the matchup and is not a projection or a promise of what happened next.

Daily streaks

Finish all five Daily rounds to extend your streak. You do not need a perfect score. Practice, shared challenges, and bonus modes do not extend or reset it. Progress and streaks are saved in this browser, not synced to an account.

More ways to play

  • Endless: keep picking, with running accuracy and a correct-pick streak. A miss does not end your run.
  • Practice: another five from the selected season, separate from your Daily result.
  • Confidence: assign each value from one to five exactly once. A correct pick earns that value, up to fifteen points. No hints.
  • Fourth Quarter: banked points are visible, with two offensive starting slots left to reveal per lineup. This is a staged historical score reveal, not an NFL clock simulation.
  • Blind Resume: compare positions, opponents, and recent form without names or headshots. Identities appear after your pick. No hints.

Find extra modes under More. Bonus modes have separate progress; the original Daily Five stays unchanged. An optional difference-maker side call asks which winning-lineup starter will have the largest points edge over the opposite starting slot. It does not change your main score.

Play with your league

Share a one-round Grudge Match or a five-round score challenge. League rooms use an anonymous nickname and unlock standings after you submit all five picks. Creator challenges let you curate a named five. Rivalries compare sets both browser profiles submitted.

Community picks and the Monday Debrief use real submitted browser-profile votes, not seeded popularity numbers. Percentages stay hidden below five picks. Profiles are not verified unique people, and these are casual games, not prize competitions.
